Find first decreasing pair from right; swap with next larger; reverse suffix.

```python
def next_permutation(nums):
    i = len(nums) - 2
    while i >= 0 and nums[i] >= nums[i+1]:
        i -= 1
    if i >= 0:
        j = len(nums) - 1
        while nums[j] <= nums[i]:
            j -= 1
        nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]
    nums[i+1:] = reversed(nums[i+1:])
    return nums
```
